newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian GDP rises 2.3 pct during nine months.
newsitem.headline: Latvian GDP rises 2.3 pct during nine months.

text.p: Latvia's gross domestic product (GDP) rose 2.3 perecent during the first nine months of 1996 and 3.8 percent in the third quarter, the statistics committee said on Friday.
The committee said in a statement that GDP was 2.04 billion lats over the first three quarters and 719 million lats in the third quarter itself.
The committee said that the 3.8 percent third quarter GDP rise compared with a 2.3 percent GDP rise in the second quarter.
Latvian GDP for the whole year has been forecast at between one and two percent. -- Riga Newsroom, +371 721 5240
